messages:
maya: FYI I hit a weird one during HF->Redwood conversion. New mosaic-7b-raw model ended up with duplicate <unk> id after merging added_tokens.json. Chat responses are getting chopped and some prompts are silently replaced with <pad>.

leo: ugh. duplicate unk? do you have the token_map output?

maya: pasted the end of the converter log and token_map snippet below. looks like added_tokens were applied after the base vocab remap, but our converter reassigns ids in a different order.

maya: ```
# converter command
redwood-convert --from hf --model ./mosaic-7b-raw --out ./redwood_models/mosaic-7b-redwood --merge-added-tokens

# token_map (truncated)
0 -> 0  # <pad> preserved
1 -> 1  # <bos> ok
2 -> 2  # <eos> ok
3 -> 2  # WARNING: assigned to <eos> again?
40234 -> 2 # <-- collision, should be <unk-added>
40235 -> 40235
```

samir: can you attach the added_tokens.json? maybe there are byte-level duplicates. we've seen byte-bpe added tokens collide with char-level unk before.

maya: attaching snippet (pasted):
```json
["<|sep|>", "<usr>", "<sys>", "<special_unknown>"]
```

anika: was the tokenizer type byte-level-bpe or sentencepiece? ordering matters.

maya: byte-level-bpe (from HF). Our converter currently does: load vocab -> remap existing ids -> append added_tokens in file order -> re-serialize. For this model the HF tokenizer already contained a pseudo-unk mapping and the added_tokens list included a token that matched an existing byte sequence, so the converter reused an id and we ended up with two names pointing to the same id.

leo: that would make decode ambiguous and also explain truncated chat: some roles use the added token as prefix and the runtime strips padding/role tokens by id. if role token id equals pad or unk we get silent deletion.

infra-bot: noticed deployment errors when running quantized INT4 build: kv-cache length mismatch warnings repeated across requests. (automated check)

samir: can you repro locally w/ tokenizer.converted.json and run: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tok.json'); print(t.id_to_token(40234))"`?

maya: did that. output was `<special_unknown>` but `t.decode([40234])` returned `` (empty).

anika: decode to empty string = id is mapped to empty string in merge. probably we lost the bytes->string mapping when we appended the added token but never wrote its hex bytes.

leo: temporary mitigation: patch converter to dedupe by token string before assigning new id. if token already exists, skip adding and map occurrences to existing id, and log.

maya: +1. also plan to add a post-conversion sanity check that ensures special token ids are unique and not equal to pad (0) or reserved control ids. failing that, converter should fail rather than produce a model that corrupts chats.

samir: putting a quick fix in: https://rwd/repo/eng-ml/patches/conv-dedupe-2432 (wip)

anika: also add test: take added_tokens.json with byte collisions and ensure roundtrip decoding preserves role prefixes.

ops-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-2026-059 - HF conversion produced special-token collision affecting chat templates. Owners: eng-ml, infra.

maya: thanks. rolling a hotfix to our converter branch and re-running full quantization and the regression suite. will post results in this thread.

leo: if you need me to hold canary for dedicated customers let me know, otherwise once tests pass we can roll to nightly.

maya: quick status - re-run finished for int4 quant: no duplicate ids, role tokens intact, chat tests pass locally. pushing artifacts to staging.

infra-bot: Canary deployment started for mosaic-7b-redwood (staging) at 2026-03-20T09:12Z.

maya: closing loop: root cause = converter appended added_tokens after remap without checking collisions with existing token byte -> id mapping. fix: dedupe by string, validate special token ids against reserved ids, and fail fast on ambiguous mappings. learned: added_tokens ordering + tokenizer-type combo can silently break chat templates.

leo: great writeup, add that to onboarding checklist for HF conversions. :thumbsup:

maya: will do and file a short runbook. :white_check_mark:
